notes.title: The Very Cool™ Update
notes.notes:
A brand new level selector? Achievements? An opening cutscene? It's all coming right at you!

[h1]Level Select Menu[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057189/79ca926443f07164f6f129d385ac71342239a15b.png[/img]
Ever wanted to revisit some iconic locations within The Interesting Company™? Do you want to experiment with all the rocket types anywhere you like? The brand new level select allows you to r[b]eplay levels you've beaten[/b] while preserving your main game progress!
[list]
[*] Access any level you've completed from the Main Menu
[*] Bring all the rockets you've unlocked to any level (may come in handy for some new challenges)
[*] Disable checkpoints to restart instantly!
[*] Save you best times, because everyone knows that the sole defining metric of an efficient transport system is speed
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057189/eb6c79a6b305af54bf9d7c0ab5dc32d3cc2a46df.png[/img]

A set of 10 new achievements that will allow you to keep track of your progress in the game, as well as offering the opportunity to [b]challenge yourself[/b] and test your skills and creativity!


[h1]Intro cutscene[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057189/35ff44b5b90d37a13b39c75153fb57ea111b7d95.png[/img]
A brand new animation on star-up to put new players into context and present The Interesting Company™ in all its quasi-legal glory.

[h1]Tweaks and bug-fixing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused the Weapon Wheel to become locked
[*] The "restart from previous checkpoint" button, more commonly known as the [b]Restart Button[/b], has been renamed to [b]Reset Button[/b]. Turns out those words mean different things
[*] That [i]one [/i]puzzle on the last level has been made easier, if you know you know
[*] Fixed minor music and dialogue bugs
[*] Added new sound effects for improved feedback
[*] Added Discord server and other social buttons to the Main Menu
[/list]

notes.title: The Blast Course Timer Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]New optional HUD information[/h1]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2493395288453682548/DFF8B43B3C239B05539DD6CBC107FF6BA2B5FA12/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

Due to popular request we have decided to include a timer and speed meter in the full release of Blast Course. 
These features are intended for the comfort and convenience of our most competitive players, so that they can easily share their results and gain deeper knowledge about this game's movement.

Because of this, they are not enabled by default, but they show up as soon as [b]Extended HUD[/b] is activated on the [i]Options[/i] menu.
The timer only resets on [i]New Game[/i], so, no cheating!
